about: Skills copied unchanged from the components' own repositories. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/sync_upstream_skills.py. A skill's optional kit_note goes into the quoted kit header above the upstream body. Never edit the copies under skills/<name>/ by hand: tests/skills.sh compares them with skills/upstream.lock.json.

sources.why: Ships inside the MCP server the kit installs, at the same version.

skills.name: exasol-mcp-server
skills.kit_note: On this kit, skip the Preprocessors section: the kit's MCP server has no preprocessor tools (`list_exasol_preprocessors`, `set_exasol_preprocessor`). Semantic SQL and JSON Tables queries already work in every session of every user through the kit's SQL preprocessor framework. Never switch a session's preprocessor, with a tool or with `ALTER SESSION SET SQL_PREPROCESSOR_SCRIPT`: that would switch off JSON Tables and every other module for the session.

skills.name: exasol-dash
skills.kit_note: On this kit, Semantic SQL is already on in every Dash Server session: its login, the read-only MCP user, gets the Semantic Views module through the kit's SQL preprocessor framework. Never give a Dash Server profile `session_init_sql` that sets `SQL_PREPROCESSOR_SCRIPT` or runs `ENABLE_SEMANTIC_SQL()`, even when `exasol_profile_validate` shows `preprocessor_active: false` or the SQL smoke check or a guidance step asks for it. Dash Server 0.2.1 only recognises the name `SEMANTIC_ADMIN.SEMANTIC_PREPROCESSOR`, not the framework (`PREPROC_RT.MASTER` or `PREPROC_RT.P_<hash>`), so that report is false on this kit. Following it would switch off JSON Tables and every other module for every dashboard on the profile. If a dashboard on a published semantic model fails its build preflight for this reason, tell the user it is a known Dash Server limitation on this kit (https://github.com/exasol-labs/dash-server/issues/6). Do not switch the preprocessor, and do not rewrite the queries over the raw tables.
skills.description: Exasol's own guide (from the dash-server repository) to writing the Dash app itself for a dashboard hosted on dash-server — layout, callbacks, the queries behind each figure, and patching or reviewing an existing app. Use it with the dash-server skill, which covers installing, starting and registering the server.

sources.why: The semantic layer's own agent skills, at the release the kit installs into the database.

skills.name: exasol-semantic-analyst
skills.kit_note: On this kit, skip every step in this skill that runs `EXECUTE SCRIPT SEMANTIC_ADMIN.ENABLE_SEMANTIC_SQL()`, `SESSION_SETUP_SQL`, `set_exasol_preprocessor` or `ALTER SESSION SET SQL_PREPROCESSOR_SCRIPT`, and skip repeating it after a reconnect. Semantic DDL and Semantic SQL already work in every session of every user through the kit's preprocessor framework; that statement would replace the framework for the session and silently switch off JSON Tables and the other modules. If a semantic statement fails with `SEMANTIC_SURFACE_001` or `not a valid GROUP BY expression`, the user runs `exakit update`. The kit's MCP server already runs every query without `row_limit` as `SELECT * FROM (<query>) LIMIT 1000`, so step 6's advice not to pass `row_limit` does not apply here: a result with exactly 1,000 rows may be incomplete, so tell the user "showing the first 1,000 rows; there may be more", and pass a larger `row_limit` when the user needs the full result.

not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-json-tables skills/*: Written for developers of that repository (they open crates/ and tests/ there); the kit's json-tables skill covers using it.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol-s: Installs Exasol Personal itself; in the kit, exakit installs and operates the database.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol-n: Configure and open the connector by hand; the kit's notebooks connect through exakit.nb with no secret in a cell.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol-i: Same subject as the mcp-server skills of the version the kit installs; one skill per subject.
not_taken.exasol-labs/exasol-agent-skills exasol: Routes to skills the kit does not ship (ITDE, SaaS, extensions).
not_taken.exasol/dbt-exasol, exasol/exasol-persona: Only skills for developing those repositories (openspec).
not_taken.exasol/mcp-server exasol-virtual-schemas: The kit ships its own exasol-virtual-schemas skill (exakit connect and exakit source, and the index of the exasol-vs-<connector> skills); two skills cannot share a name, and the adapter, JDBC and pushdown set-up the upstream guide teaches is what exakit connect does for the user.
